issues.description: In both angry views, Karo retains a pale, upward-curving tooth/mouth fragment inside a dark brown patch. This reads as a residual grin beneath the angry brows, rather than a coherent angry mouth, and the patch interrupts the surrounding painted beard texture.
issues.repair: Cleanly remove the happy-mouth interior and restore the underlying beard texture. Build the angry mouth as a complete replacement with a clearly tense or downturned contour, preserving the source mouth's warm lip edging and painted finish without leaving tooth fragments or a flat cover patch.
